company_profile: Anthropic is an AI safety company building reliable, interpretable and steerable AI systems, offering its Claude models to businesses and developers through the Claude Developer Platform.
title: Applied AI Engineer
summary: Senior AI Engineer with 8+ years building production LLM applications across Healthcare, Telecom and AIOps, from prototype to deployment. Designs agent architectures in LangGraph, RAG systems and document-extraction agents, with careful prompting and automated evaluation frameworks, tracing and observability. Has worked hands-on with client teams on technical POCs for 15+ clients, turning requirements into architectures and shipped Python applications with FastAPI, Docker and MLflow. Currently building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

project.name: Agent Evaluation Reference Kit
bullets: Built a reusable reference implementation of a tool-using agent with prompt templates and context engineering patterns, helping product teams prototype LLM features for healthcare and fintech use cases.
Evaluated agent behaviour with a custom evaluation suite of LLM graders and tracing, documented the architecture with diagrams and sample code, and served the agent through FastAPI.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Applied AI Engineer role on the Startups team. As a Senior AI Engineer I build LLM applications that go into production: agents, retrieval, evaluation and the plumbing around them. Much of my career has also been spent next to client engineers, scoping a problem with them and then writing the code together.

Anthropic's focus on reliable, steerable models matches how I already work, since I build on Claude daily and care most about a system behaving the same on the hundredth run as on the first. On a personal note, my fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to London together and settle there long term.

For startup teams building on Claude, I would bring practical agent design and evaluation. In my current role I shipped a lab-extraction agent on Claude Opus 4.7 that handles about 1,800 lab documents, and built evaluation pipelines that cut human review by 43%. At Viavi I delivered POCs for 15+ clients, which taught me to explain trade-offs plainly.

Outside work, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. It keeps me honest about safety and about building for people who depend on the tool. I would welcome a conversation about the role.
